name: Tanihara Manami
source: Satoru and Natsumi's daughter. She loves her papa so much she wants to have a baby with him. When she learns he wants to have a baby with her too she's so excited she wants to tell everyone.
translation: Satoru and Natsumi's daughter. She loves her papa so much she wants to have a baby with him. When she learns he wants to have a baby with her too she's so excited she wants to tell everyone.
